primary_meaning: Inadequate human attempts to cover personal sin, guilt, or shame through self-made efforts (often contrasted with God's later provision of covering)
primary_basis: Genesis 3:21 (contrasting divine covering with animal skins)

alternatives.meaning: Mere literal/historical detail of improvised clothing with no intended deeper symbolism
General emblem of human modesty or the onset of self-consciousness after the Fall

notes: Consensus in Christian biblical interpretation and teaching centers on the Genesis Fall narrative; other biblical fig imagery (e.g., cursed fig tree, sitting under a fig tree) is not normally applied to the specific phrase 'fig leaves'.
